name: PNG Phonics Assessment
source: PNG Language Program — 'PNG Phonics Assessment.pdf' (document title 'PNG Phonics Assessment'); pairs with the Reading by Science phonics units and smartboard games
licence_note: Item lists and scoring rules only (facts). No instructional prose from the source document is reproduced.
purpose: Intervention placement: find the lowest phonics level whose sounds a student does not yet know, for students not receiving phonics instruction in core time.

administration.letter_id_task: The student says the NAME of each letter; the assessor circles any letter named wrongly.
administration.sound_task: For each level, the assessor circles any grapheme whose SOUND the student does not know.
administration.entry_point: Always start at the lowest level whose sounds the student does not know.
administration.prerequisite: If the whole class has not yet had phonics, teach phonics units 1-7 and games 1-9 in order before using this assessment.

scoring.unit: one point per grapheme whose sound is known

decision_rules.action: teach just those sounds by direct instruction until the student recalls them automatically the next day

decision_rules.condition: fewer than 3 sounds known in a level
decision_rules.action: teach the matching lessons and games until every sound is automatic on a new day before instruction

decision_rules.condition: all sounds known but still not reading with automaticity
decision_rules.action: assess sight-word vocabulary and morphological awareness, and begin repeated-reading drills

source_inconsistencies: Letter ID: j is missing from the printed list and the total is /27 for a 26-letter alphabet.
Level 2 prints 8 items but scores /7; Level 6 prints 6 items but scores /5.
Level 5's sixth item is printed as 'ook'.
relationship_to_sequences: This is a different, shorter ordering from the 16-level PNG scope & sequence in data/sequences/png-language-program.json — it is a 7-level intervention screener, closest in shape to a Letters-and-Sounds style order.
